The '''2023 Retro League Event 5''' was the fifth event of the [[2023 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (24 September – 5 November 2023), played in [[Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)]] format.<ref name="t82167" /> [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 24 September – 5 November 2023
* '''Players:''' 56 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
